x: Enter your name on the list in Belgrave Hall or phone me. SATURDAY 20th DECEMBER - KEN COLYER 'LIVE' AT BELGRAVE HALL Another visit from Ken Colyer's All Star Jazz Band.

The jazz evening organised by GORDON was another great success and KEN COLYER and his band enjoyed themselves as much as the revellers. Instead of halting the festivities at midnight, the band played on for an extra hour.
The Jaguars, Ken Colyer, the Barn Dance, the River Boat Shuffle. These with jumble sales raised approximately £520.
